issue.body:
## Parent

Part of [验证 Binance Spot Live 可信执行](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121). Starting implementation/review baseline `dev@91e2f2a99808a1a97004bef396a23c14b764ca4d`. The completed exact-account capacity prerequisite supplies the immutable current/captured contract. Retain the approved single-ticket/public external seam.

## What to build

An existing immutable ordinary Binance Live BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT Proposal can explicitly collect actual ORDERS interval definitions and authenticated exact-account interval usage through bounded fixed GETs, then show original count/limit/units, coverage/read windows/clock uncertainty, age and sanitized recovery in current and captured/pre-arm review. Open inventory, interval usage, request-weight budgets and local reservations remain distinct. This complete read-only source dependency supports later owning dynamic qualification; no financial authority, probe, mutation or new account/source setup.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1. Trusted local get/explicit CAS refresh derives immutable Proposal/hash, exact ordinary account/UID/key, canonical symbol and source/rule/market/policy/workspace/session/time/ownership bindings. Renderer endpoint/symbol/UID/count/limit/interval/time/authority/foreign intent is rejected; no implicit provider read or unnecessary private collection.
- [x] AC2. Fixed filtered public exchangeInfo/clock and signed USER_DATA account/rateLimit/order use actual original UID proof, existing vault/zeroization/HMAC/recvWindow and P3 actual UID+IP costs/caps/shared418/429. No fabricated public UID, reset, redirect, CP lock over I/O, unrelated inventory scan or provider mutation/probe. Overall deadline30s and12s completion margin remain bounded.
- [x] AC3. Actual declared ORDERS tuple/limit coverage is matched to original counters. Strict duplicate/original integer/range/size/array parsing preserves signed64-bit values as exact strings;512KiB/response,32 intervals,8 runtime slots. Missing/extra/unknown/contradictory coverage is unavailable/unresolved, not unlimited/zero/truncated complete. At/over-limit count and zero reported limit are not clamped or treated as disabled.
- [x] AC4. Account-wide all-key/IP/API interval usage remains separate from open-order filter counts, read budgets and local reservations. No local fill/cancel/expiry or header absence fabricates decrement/reset. Provider clock/read windows are not counter snapshot time; no manufactured resetAt/remaining slots/execution-qualified window or atomic guarantee. Cached get/history cannot renew first receipts; conservative age/possible rollover retirement is explicit.
- [x] AC5. Pending/failed refresh, expiry/account/key/source/rule/market/policy/Proposal/workspace/session/time changes, reopen, newer ownership and late/deadline results retire current inputs with sanitized recovery. Reopen restores configuration/history only; no implicit private collection or old success while pending/error.
- [x] AC6. Actual React→Rust current/captured/pre-arm review explains identity, separate quota concepts, original units/coverage/time uncertainty/read windows/digests and explicit refresh/error/recovery. Keyboard1280/768/390 no overflow; captured history has no refresh/polling or receipt renewal and cannot be rewritten by current source changes. Only approved bounded aggregate/digests persist; no raw private account/definition/counter response or secret.
- [x] AC7. Input qualification always remains UNAVAILABLE/not execution qualified. No complete-rule/rights/quote/liquidity/permissions/health/feesFX/funding/Arm/consent/Prepare/reservation/Gateway upgrade or positive financial snapshot setter. Exact CANCEL/reconciliation preserved; full parent/map/native/hosted/financial/physical/prototype/main gates stay separate.
- [x] AC8. Genuine public RED/GREEN and external normal/fault/lifecycle/scope/precision/coverage/quota tests, current full/affected rule/capacity/Hot/Gateway checks, schema/bilingual/manifest/traceability, ordinary build/Gateway pin, actual frozen UI, independent serial Standards→Spec and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff establish this source slice. No CI or broader acceptance claim without corresponding evidence.

## Blocked by

No open blocker. Completed [提供 Binance 精确账户开放订单与容量输入](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/126) is the native completed dependency. S28, physical lifecycle and later owning qualification are separate scheduling/fog, not manufactured edges.

## Standing boundaries

Use the paired S29.6 specification published on the parent. Confirmed single-ticket granularity and highest public React/Rust/disposable-storage/external-provider seam apply unchanged; no repeat approval quiz. Implementation starts only after this planning handoff is published and verified. Existing complete-goal scope remains; real transactions need a concrete separately approved plan/human action, and main remains human-reviewed PR only after the full map is verified.
